'''Coruscant blush wine''' was a variety of [[Wine/Legends|wine]]<ref name="LE" /> related to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> The wine was served aboard the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] [[Gem of Alderaan]],<ref name="GA">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref> and at the annual [[Vor-cal Feast]] held at [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE" />
